data.action: 手持苍蓝电弧双刃凌空跃起斩击，白狼尾狂甩，狂气大笑露出尖牙
data.camera: wide shot, low angle, explosive dynamic action
data.description: 【拉普兰德 · 狂月下的双刃猎杀】叙拉古废墟古罗马圆形剧场遗址上，血色满月高悬。拉普兰德手握双刃逆风跃起，银白色的凌乱长发在月光下如狂狼鬃毛般狂舞，双刃上缠绕着苍蓝色的源石电弧，狂气的笑容与尖牙展露无遗——「哈哈哈哈！来吧，让我见识一下你们的挣扎！千万不要太快死掉啊！」
data.lighting: 血色残月冷光与双刃苍蓝源石雷电强光
data.location: 叙拉古荒原古罗马斗兽场废墟
data.promptProse: Lappland leaps above the ruined Siracusan amphitheater, gripping both swords and baring sharp teeth in a wild grin. Keep the ragged mercenary coat, wind-lifted silver hair and low-angle wide action framing. A broken arch occupies the near side; staggered arena tiers recede behind her airborne figure, with the dark central arena visible below. The blood moon traces the upper rim of the ruin. Blue Originium arcs already running along the blades illuminate her gloves and nearby cloth folds, and a brief blue reflection catches the nearest cracked stone edge without filling the entire arena with uniform light.
data.title: 拉普兰德 · 狂月下的双刃猎杀
